sites.name: Howard's Gulch Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $15 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.season: Facilities open as weather permits; usually mid-May to late October.
sites.about: Set back off the highway in a tree lined gulch this campground is a very quiet and pleasant place to spend the weekend or your entire vacation.A shorthiking trail is available for nature viewingas this is one of the several Basin and Range Birding Trail stops within the Modoc National Forest.A…
sites.directions: From Alturas travel west on Hwy 299 past Canby to Hwy 139. Turn north on Hwy 139 and go 4 miles to the campground entrance on the lefeet.
sites.restrictions: Dogs on leash only. Please clean up afeeter your dog. Camping limit 14 days.
sites.reservations: Reservations are not accepted. All sites are first come, first served.

sites.name: Reservoir F Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.season: Facilities open as weather permits; usually mid-May to late October.
sites.about: The campsites at Reservoir F are spacious and close to the shoreline. The early morning sun greets campers from across the lake as the afeeternoons areshaded by the tall pines.
